Messages.Author: Nick AA
Messages.Body:
Hi, just wanted to make some things clear that has come up when I
played:

1) In combat, acting minion 1 plays combat ends. Can minion 2 play
majesty at superior and untap as both are combat ends?

2) In madness network decks I often see the rack included, does it
work with homunculus to gain 2 blood at each madness untap?

3) Can you play manuever cards and not use the manuever? I.e to cycle
manuever cards while still being at short range for that IG.

4) How do you build a deck based around trap best?

5) Similar to question 4 but isn't conquer the beast a lousy card? How
do you use it if not so?

6) minion 1 plays form of mist superior and continues at +1 stealth.
The other minion, which was in combat, has a sportbike and wakes. Can
minion 2 block again?

7) Does kiss of ra + decapitate work?

/ Nick

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nick AA wrote:
> 1) In combat, acting minion 1 plays combat ends. Can minion 2 play
> majesty at superior and untap as both are combat ends?

Yes.

> 2) In madness network decks I often see the rack included, does it
> work with homunculus to gain 2 blood at each madness untap?

No. It works each of the minion's untap phase, not untaps.

> 3) Can you play manuever cards and not use the manuever? I.e to cycle
> manuever cards while still being at short range for that IG.

No.

> 6) minion 1 plays form of mist superior and continues at +1 stealth.
> The other minion, which was in combat, has a sportbike and wakes. Can
> minion 2 block again?

Yes.

> 7) Does kiss of ra + decapitate work?

No. Combat cards (e.g. Decapitate) can only be played in combat.
